# benchmark-pelican

> Deterministic SVG spatial-reasoning benchmark for birds riding bicycles.

Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/benchmark-pelican
Repository: https://github.com/pooriaarab/benchmark-pelican
Directory: https://aibenchmarkindex.com/benchmarks/benchmark-pelican

## Exports

The root exports `benchmark`, `run`, and `score`. `benchmark-pelican/api` exports the fetch-style `handler`. `benchmark-pelican/mcp` exports MCP builders.

## Commands

The CLI supports list, show, run, score, card, provenance, index-entry, serve, and mcp. Use the mock provider for offline verification.

## Data and grading

Thirty single-answer tasks come from one canonical prompt and a seeded animal and bicycle grid. The grader rejects unsafe SVG, then scores geometry and coverage. It does not use a model judge.

Public seed: 20261015. Hidden outputs must stay outside the package. Detailed rules ship in `docs/grading.md`.

## Gallery

Run `npm run gallery -- report.json` in the repository to write `artifacts/gallery.html`.

## Verification

Run `npm run ci:local`. The report is `artifacts/e2e-report.json`.
